_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: days in the same month, or a number of days to split into weeks; 2: days counted across one or two months, or one year on; 3: days counted across several months with a leap year, several years on, or the holidays in a month; 4: odd days counted from the start of the calendar (centuries), or a year with the same calendar. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
